keepWarm.closedTitle: Session closed: only a ping in its terminal warms its cache. Reopen it to keep it warm.
keepWarm.buttonTitle: Keeps the prompt cache warm by sending an automatic ping (paid)
keepWarm.menuLabel: Whenever less than 5 min of cache remain, gld sends a short message in the session's terminal. Each ping is a billed turn and shows up in the conversation. Keeping warm stops if the session is closed.
keepWarm.coldLabel: Cold cache: a first message ("ok") rebuilds all of it, which costs far more than a ping; keep-warm then takes over. Every ping is a billed turn.
keepWarm.bannerActive: Keep-warm is on — it costs money.
keepWarm.bannerHint: a ping goes out when less than 5 min of cache remain
keepWarm.hotTitle: The prompt cache lasts one hour after the last message
